request: What impact did passing Obamacare have on the federal budget?

reply.reply: CBO estimated in 2010 that the ACA combined with its reconciliation changes would reduce federal deficits by $138 billion over 2010–2019 (CRS R41126, PDF citation in the brief). This was a prospective estimate for the combined legislation—not a measure of the ACA alone or of actual budget outcomes. See the [brief](output/briefs/case-20261025-185623-5b90.html) for details.
reply.reasoning: Presentation independently verified finding 680 as a direct estimate of net deficit impact, and clarified its scope and period. The reply avoids implying the estimate covered ACA alone or actual outcomes.
